parent_objective: design broader extreme-fault scenario distribution after M737 hard-negative sparsity and user coverage concern

public_gates: M739 defines current-model proxy and four-wheel-required fault taxonomy
M739 defines matched counterfactual source generation
M739 defines public and holdout split policy
M739 defines sequence intervention and outcome gates
actor update PPO and promotion remain blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not inject hidden fault labels into actor observations
do not claim true single-wheel physics from current single-track proxies
do not collapse public and holdout distributions

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs a broader matched counterfactual fault distribution before more objective work
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no new data wave result and no checkpoint claim
stop_condition: stop if current-model proxy and four-wheel-required faults are conflated
stop if matched counterfactual cases are not defined
stop if public and holdout split policy is absent
stop if actor training PPO or promotion is admitted
fallback_plan: if single-track proxies cannot represent a fault, label it four-wheel-required and keep it out of current-model gates
if scenario count is too large, stage a smoke wave before full coverage
if M740 finds no outcome rows, audit before simulator fidelity or sequence-intervention redesign
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M738 promotes from corpus export audit to broader extreme-fault coverage

hypothesis: A broader extreme-fault distribution with matched counterfactuals is needed before the next objective branch because current public positives and hard negatives are too narrow.
success_criteria: M739 defines the v3 fault taxonomy
M739 separates current-model proxy faults from four-wheel-required faults
M739 defines scenario randomization and fault-onset timing
M739 defines public and holdout split policy
M739 defines source-balance sentinel action and outcome gates
M739 blocks actor update PPO and promotion
M739 admits only a no-training M740 implementation
failure_criteria: design claims true single-wheel physics from current single-track proxies
design omits public and holdout split policy
design admits PPO or checkpoint promotion
decision_rule: M739 may only design the no-training v3 extreme-fault distribution. It must not admit objective design PPO or promotion until M740 is run and audited.
